connectors.name: FINOS Common Architecture Language Model (CALM)
connectors.authorityRationale: Governed, machine-readable architecture-as-code specification and toolchain with patterns, controls and validation for regulated environments.

license.note: Verify per-path licensing and CALM schema terms before redistributing source-derived content.

limitations: CALM is an interoperability source, not AIW’s canonical model
schema versions must be pinned
AI-generated CALM must be validated before use

connectors.name: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center
connectors.authorityRationale: Official Microsoft repository containing cloud design patterns, performance anti-patterns, technology-choice guidance and reference architectures.

license.note: Ingest atomic claims and links; do not republish documentation wholesale.

limitations: Vendor-specific advice must be labelled Azure-specific
some patterns are general but examples are product-bound

connectors.name: AWS Serverless Patterns Collection
connectors.authorityRationale: Official executable integration patterns backed by infrastructure-as-code and Serverless Land metadata.

license.note: Treat patterns as provider-specific examples; preserve source and license metadata.

limitations: AWS-specific
community submissions vary in depth
deployment success is not proof of architectural suitability

connectors.name: AWS Solutions Constructs
connectors.authorityRationale: Official multi-service CDK constructs that encode repeatable well-architected defaults and service integrations.

license.note: Preserve attribution; generated AIW templates remain independent representations.

limitations: Provider-specific
construct defaults still require workload review

connectors.name: Azure Common Resource Modules / Verified Modules
connectors.authorityRationale: Microsoft-maintained curated Bicep modules with CI validation and versioned publishing.

license.note: Use module metadata and interfaces; validate licensing before embedding module source.

limitations: Infrastructure modules do not encode complete software design rationale
Azure-specific

connectors.name: Google Cloud Foundation Fabric
connectors.authorityRationale: Google-maintained Terraform modules and end-to-end blueprints for cloud foundations and application infrastructure.

license.note: Use interfaces and metadata; do not copy module implementations without license review.

limitations: GCP-specific
infrastructure blueprints do not replace application architecture reasoning

connectors.name: Domain-Driven Design Crew Methods
connectors.authorityRationale: Practitioner-maintained, structured DDD modelling methods that connect event storming, domain message flow, bounded contexts and aggregates.

license.note: Preserve attribution and share-alike obligations for any adapted canvas content.

limitations: Methods require facilitation and judgement
not a universal architecture pattern authority

connectors.name: Apache Camel Enterprise Integration Patterns
connectors.authorityRationale: Mature open-source integration framework organized around known Enterprise Integration Patterns and a large component catalog.

license.note: Use pattern/component metadata with attribution; avoid coupling AIW to Camel runtime types.

limitations: Runtime-specific implementation details must be separated from general EIP concepts

connectors.name: AsyncAPI Specification and Tooling
connectors.authorityRationale: Linux Foundation specification and tooling ecosystem for event-driven API contracts.

license.note: Preserve specification attribution and version pinning.

limitations: Defines contracts, not complete architecture suitability
protocol bindings require version-aware handling

connectors.name: Open Application Model
connectors.authorityRationale: Open model for higher-level cloud-native application components, traits, policies and workflows across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

license.note: Use model concepts and schema mappings with attribution.

limitations: Specification evolution is slower than active implementations
cloud-native focus

connectors.name: Kubernetes Patterns Examples
connectors.authorityRationale: Executable examples accompanying a recognized cloud-native pattern language.

license.note: Examples correspond to a published book; preserve repository licensing and avoid reproducing book text.

limitations: Examples alone do not capture all pattern forces and trade-offs

connectors.name: Service Mesh Patterns
connectors.authorityRationale: Declarative YAML patterns for service-mesh and cloud-native configurations, designed for use with Meshery.

license.note: Preserve attribution and source pattern identifiers.

limitations: Configuration validity does not guarantee workload suitability
mesh-specific

connectors.name: LikeC4
connectors.authorityRationale: Active software architecture modeling language with custom notation, custom element types, arbitrary nesting and generated views.

license.note: Implement syntax/model adapters; do not copy implementation code into AIW.

limitations: External notation must map to AIW semantics without loss
not a pattern authority

connectors.name: Structurizr DSL and Java Model
connectors.authorityRationale: Reference implementation and active home of the Structurizr DSL for C4 architecture models and views.

license.note: Use public language semantics and generated fixtures; verify module licensing before code reuse.

limitations: C4 abstraction levels are narrower than AIW’s full metamodel
older structurizr/dsl repository is archived

connectors.name: C4-PlantUML
connectors.authorityRationale: Widely used open-source C4 notation library for PlantUML and diagram-as-code workflows.

license.note: Generate C4-PlantUML output without bundling third-party source by default.

limitations: Rendering notation is not a semantic knowledge source
sequence semantics require separate support

connectors.name: arc42 Architecture Documentation Template
connectors.authorityRationale: Mature open-source structure for practical software architecture documentation and communication.

license.note: Respect attribution/share terms for adapted template content.

limitations: Documentation structure is not a design rule set

connectors.name: ArchUnit
connectors.authorityRationale: Established Java architecture-test library for package, layer, slice, dependency and cycle rules.

license.note: Generate independent ArchUnit tests; do not copy source implementation.

limitations: Java bytecode scope
cannot validate runtime topology or business rationale

connectors.name: jQAssistant
connectors.authorityRationale: Graph-based software analysis and architecture constraint framework with extensible scanners and rules.

license.note: Keep integration process-boundary based unless legal review approves deeper linkage.

limitations: GPL integration boundary must be managed
scanner coverage varies by language/plugin

connectors.name: Backstage Software Catalog
connectors.authorityRationale: CNCF developer-portal framework with a mature software catalog for components, systems, domains, APIs, resources and ownership.

license.note: Use catalog schemas and API integration; preserve AIW as the architecture source of truth.

limitations: Backstage catalog is not a dynamic architecture source of truth
catalog entity semantics are coarser than AIW

connectors.name: FINOS AI Reference Architecture Library
connectors.authorityRationale: Curated financial-services AI reference architectures developed by FSIs, integrators and technology providers with expert validation.

license.note: Verify architecture-specific licenses and attribution before template adaptation.

limitations: Domain-specific to financial services and AI
reference architectures require contextual tailoring

connectors.name: SAP Architecture Center
connectors.authorityRationale: Official SAP repository of solution reference architectures and reusable product/service-level architecture guidance.

license.note: Use source-specific attribution and do not treat SAP product guidance as vendor-neutral.

limitations: Vendor-specific
architecture suitability depends on SAP landscape context

connectors.name: CNCF TAG Security Reference Architectures
connectors.authorityRationale: CNCF community security papers and reference architectures covering cloud-native security and software supply chain concerns.

license.note: Preserve CNCF attribution and source document links.

limitations: Some papers are broad guidance, not machine-verifiable requirements

connectors.name: IBM Cloud-Native Patterns
connectors.authorityRationale: IBM-authored collection of cloud-native control-loop and stateful-streaming patterns.

license.note: Candidate source pending deeper maintenance and license review.

limitations: Narrow scope
maintenance cadence requires review

connectors.name: Cloud-Native Architecture Quality Model
connectors.authorityRationale: Research-backed quality model focused on design-time evaluation of cloud-native software architectures and validated through survey work.

license.note: Use as research evidence; retain paper/repository provenance.

limitations: Research model requires expert calibration before production scoring

connectors.name: OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop Demo
connectors.authorityRationale: Official near-real-world microservice demo showing OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors and observability topology.

license.note: Use architecture metadata and test fixtures; verify code license for any reuse.

limitations: Demonstration architecture intentionally includes failure scenarios and is not a universal production blueprint

connectors.name: Google Cloud Microservices Demo
connectors.authorityRationale: Official cloud-first sample application with multiple microservices, Kubernetes, Istio and gRPC.

license.note: Use architecture metadata and test fixtures with attribution.

limitations: Sample architecture is educational, not a universal recommendation

connectors.name: Google Cloud Software Delivery Blueprint
connectors.authorityRationale: Official blueprint for application infrastructure, self-service landing zones and software delivery practices.

license.note: Use architecture claims and metadata; review Terraform module licenses separately.

limitations: GCP implementation context
platform architecture rather than application design

connectors.name: AWS SaaS Factory EKS Reference Architecture
connectors.authorityRationale: Official end-to-end multi-tenant SaaS reference architecture for EKS with identity, isolation, routing and deployment guidance.

license.note: Provider-specific reference content; preserve source and version.

limitations: AWS/EKS-specific
sample does not replace tenancy threat modeling

connectors.name: Microsoft Agent Skills — Azure Architecture
connectors.authorityRationale: Microsoft-maintained LLM skill corpus that packages Azure architecture guidance for AI assistants.

license.note: Use to study AI skill packaging and source links; do not treat prompts as independent architecture authority.

limitations: Skill prompts may simplify or lag underlying guidance
must resolve claims to primary sources

connectors.name: Java Design Patterns
connectors.authorityRationale: Large, actively maintained collection of well-commented pattern implementations developed by community practitioners.

license.note: Use as secondary implementation evidence; corroborate architecture claims with stronger sources.

limitations: Java-centric
community examples are not normative architecture guidance

connectors.name: Awesome Software and Architectural Design Patterns
connectors.authorityRationale: Broad curated index useful for discovery of additional pattern sources.

license.note: Use links for candidate-source discovery only.

limitations: Curated links vary in authority and freshness
must never directly change production rules

connectors.name: Awesome Software Architecture
connectors.authorityRationale: Continuously curated index of software architecture resources, patterns and practices.

license.note: Use only to discover primary sources and emerging topics.

limitations: Not an authoritative source
linked material has mixed licensing and quality

connectors.name: Awesome Anti-Pattern Index
connectors.authorityRationale: Curated survey and resource index for software and architecture anti-patterns.

license.note: Use as a research index; claims require primary-source corroboration.

limitations: Mixed source quality
not suitable for direct rule generation

connectors.name: System Design Primer
connectors.authorityRationale: Popular educational system-design repository with broad concept coverage and worked examples.

license.note: Use as educational discovery material, never as a hard-rule authority.

limitations: Interview-oriented
simplifications and unverified diagrams require caution

connectors.name: jMolecules Architectural Abstractions
connectors.authorityRationale: Mature code-level abstractions for DDD building blocks, events and architectural styles, with ArchUnit and jQAssistant verification integrations.

license.note: Use public abstractions and metadata to derive AIW mappings; verify module-level licenses before code reuse.

aiwLeverage: Map DDD entities, value objects, aggregates and events to AIW component types
Reverse-map code annotations into intended architecture
Provide code-level realizations of layered, onion and hexagonal styles
limitations: Java/Kotlin oriented
annotations express intent but do not prove runtime behavior
AIW must not require jMolecules in generated systems

connectors.name: Spring Modulith
connectors.authorityRationale: Official Spring project for domain-driven application modules, module-boundary verification, module-level testing, observability and documentation.

license.note: Use module-model concepts and adapter metadata; verify license before copying implementation code or documentation.

aiwLeverage: Import discovered application modules and dependencies
Compare intended module boundaries with implementation
Generate module documentation and observability mappings
limitations: Spring Boot specific
module conformance does not validate business boundaries by itself
not a universal modular-monolith definition

connectors.name: Context Mapper DSL
connectors.authorityRationale: Open-source DSL grounded in Domain-Driven Design patterns for strategic context mapping and service decomposition.

license.note: Prioritize an import/export adapter and claim extraction; verify license and generator-template terms before redistribution.

aiwLeverage: Import/export bounded contexts, domains and context-map relationships
Map strategic DDD patterns into AIW relationship semantics
Generate context-map views from the canonical graph
limitations: Strategic DDD scope is narrower than the full AIW metamodel
some generators and integrations have separate constraints

connectors.name: Context Mapper Discovery Library
connectors.authorityRationale: Extensible reverse-engineering library that derives Context Mapper models from source-code evidence.

license.note: Use as a design reference for pluggable discovery strategies; verify license before integrating code.

aiwLeverage: Compare reverse-engineered context maps with intended AIW models
Create plug-in discovery contracts for multiple languages
limitations: Discovered boundaries are hypotheses requiring architect confirmation
coverage depends on language/framework adapters

connectors.name: CNCF Landscape Graph
connectors.authorityRationale: CNCF-maintained graph and data model for navigating the cloud-native technology landscape and relationships.

license.note: Use project/category metadata for taxonomy discovery; do not infer architectural suitability from landscape membership.

aiwLeverage: Map projects to capabilities and ecosystems
Identify technology aliases and lifecycle metadata
limitations: Landscape inclusion is not endorsement or design guidance
technology metadata must not become a recommendation score without separate evidence

connectors.name: Meshery Models and Design Templates
connectors.authorityRationale: Cloud-native visual design platform with schema-driven components, typed relationships and reusable infrastructure/application design templates.

license.note: Build a model/template adapter and retain attribution; do not copy UI or template content without license review.

aiwLeverage: Import cloud-native component models and relationships
Compare AIW deployment designs with Meshery models
Learn schema-driven component depiction and relationship validation
limitations: Primarily cloud-native/Kubernetes focused
valid deployable templates are not automatically good application architecture
AIW remains the software-design source of truth

connectors.name: Git-native Architecture Catalog
connectors.authorityRationale: Schema-driven Git-native architecture catalog useful as an interoperability and authoring reference.

license.note: Use public schemas and file conventions only through an explicit adapter.

limitations: Early-stage community project
not an authoritative architecture method or pattern source

connectors.name: it@M Reference Architecture Components
connectors.authorityRationale: Public-sector collection of reusable reference-architecture components, libraries and configurations.

license.note: Use as contextual implementation evidence and preserve attribution.

connectors.name: Ardalis Clean Architecture Template
connectors.authorityRationale: Widely used .NET implementation template for dependency-inverted clean/hexagonal/onion architecture.

Provide code scaffolding and architecture-test fixtures

connectors.name: Developer Roadmap

No production recommendation authority

No production recommendation authority
